title: Кухня как оркестр  (The Kitchen as an Orchestra)

segments.t: After Lyova visits Viktor and advises him to apologize to Nagiyev, Denis begins his trial shift in the kitchen with Max's coaching—just as Viktor walks back into the restaurant completely sober. Listen in Russian first.
Да ты же музыкант. Подойди творчески.
Денис, уже полчаса, как идёт испытательный срок.
Let's look closely at each Russian line in this scene.
'Viktor Petrovich, let's go home.' Lyova continues dryly on the spot, to clear the air between them once and for all.
'Please be reasonable.' Pointing to the reasonable right here, Lyova puts the emphasis on "blagorazumny" ("reasonable") in the middle of the talk.
'Ask Dmitry Vladimirovich for forgiveness.' Discussing the forgiveness right here, Lyova leans on "proshcheniya" ("forgiveness", a form of "proshcheniye") to give the remark its edge.
'Max, I am definitely going to mess up here.' Denis reacts plainly with a shrug, leaving no doubt about where he stands.
Да ты же музыкант. Подойди творчески.
'Come on, you are a musician. Approach it creatively.' Bringing up the creatively beside Denis, Max leans on "tvorcheski" ("creatively") to give the whole sentence its punch.
'Imagine that the kitchen is your orchestra.' Max proceeds bluntly with Lyova, testing Lyova's reaction in the middle of the exchange.
Денис, уже полчаса, как идёт испытательный срок.
'Denis, your trial period started half an hour ago.' Lyova proceeds sharply facing Denis, refusing to let the moment slip past.
'Got it. On my way.' Denis continues smoothly with Lyova and reaches for the Russian word "ponyal" ("understood", built from "ponyat") right at the center of the line.
'Hello, everyone.' Denis readily extends this casual greeting in the exchange using "privet" ("hi") — the everyday informal hello used between friends and close coworkers.
'Prep work runs in the Lavrov blood.' Max speaks frankly in their talk, steering the talk right where he wants it.
'And what if Nagiyev sees me here?' Denis follows up plainly right here and chooses "uvidit" ("will see", from the root "uvidet") so Lyova hears the exact meaning.

'Folks, it is the second coming of the Chef out there.' Confirming how second things are beside Denis, Lyova links the Russian words directly in the present with no word for "am", "is", or "are" needed.
Да ты же музыкант. Подойди творчески.
Денис, уже полчаса, как идёт испытательный срок.
That covers Max comparing the kitchen to an orchestra and Viktor returning sober. Listen for how Russian imperatives encourage creative thinking. Until next time!

lines.fragment: Денис, уже полчаса, как идет испытательный срок.
